C0246.title: Shanghai Customs Seizes Masks Infringing Minions Animation Copyright
C0246.summary: In July 2021, Shanghai Customs at Waigaoqiao Port conducted a thorough inspection of a shipment with multiple declaration irregularities and discovered over 220,000 disposable non-medical masks bearing the Minions animated character hidden in the rear of a container. After confirming with the rights holder, Universal City Studios LLC, that the masks infringed the copyright of the Minions character
